query: UPDATE bulk_sends SET status = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bulk_send_rows WHERE account_id = $1 AND bulk_send_id = $2 AND status = 'pending') THEN 'sending' ELSE 'completed' END, finished_at = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bulk_send_rows WHERE account_id = $1 AND bulk_send_id = $2 AND status = 'pending') THEN NULL ELSE $3::timestamptz END WHERE account_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND status IN ('queued', 'sending')
